News.Title: New release of the Multiple App Launcher (1.4.0)
News.ContentShort: We released the new, v1.4.0 version of the Multiple App Launcher project with...
News.Content: We released the new, v1.4.0 version of the Multiple App Launcher with added Linux support, more robust error handling, simplified launcher and settings logic, logging, a new icon, and with a compile script for the power users, found on the Github repo.

News.Title: Multiple App Launcher: release on Linux

News.Content: We made the decision to release our Multiple App Launcher application on Linux as well making it cross-platform. The release is expected to be before June of 2026.

News.Title: BREAKING NEWS: Open sourcing the 'Multiple App Launcher' project
News.ContentShort: To increase the trust, visibility and customisation, we are open sourcing the...
